generation_prompt:
Create a premium Spanish medical mind map, landscape 1536x1024, ivory background navy text teal/amber accents, consistent polished Ben Carson educational editorial. Incorporate supplied original institutional logo top left accurately, no new invented branding. Title "OLFATO: DE LA MOLÉCULA AL PATRÓN". Four illustrated panels with generous spacing, crisp labels, arrows correct direction, limited text as below.
Upper left large anatomical panel "1 · RECEPTOR Y TRAYECTO". Anatomical schematic with olfactory bulb at TOP above a horizontal perforated cribriform plate, olfactory epithelium BELOW plate, mucus at the BOTTOM facing nasal lumen. One bipolar receptor neuron in epithelium: dendrite descends to knob with cilia in mucus; its basal axon extends UP through a hole of cribriform plate to a glomerulus within bulb. Distinct support cells. Bulb output arrow to small separate box "Corteza olfativa". Labels "Bulbo olfativo", "Glomérulo", "Lámina cribosa", "Axón", "Neurona bipolar", "Cilios en moco". NO taste bud, no axon pointing into nasal air, no glomerulus in epithelium. Mark "Esquema simplificado".
Upper right "2 · TRANSDUCCIÓN" close-up cilium membrane with odorant and receptor protein, plus clear causal sequence in six connected rounded boxes "Odorante" → "Receptor · proteína G" → "AMPc aumenta" → "Canales catiónicos" → "Despolarización" → "Potenciales de acción". Intracellular AMPc is NOT a molecule inhaled from outside.
Lower left "3 · CÓDIGO COMBINATORIO" a clean schematic matrix with rows "Olor A", "Olor B" and columns "R1", "R2", "R3", "R4". For A highlight R1/R2/R4; for B highlight R2/R3. Caption "Ejemplo conceptual, no datos experimentales". Two distinct patterns; not one receptor for only one odor. Exact short statement "Una molécula puede activar varios tipos de receptor".
Lower right "4 · PROCESAMIENTO" simple functional route boxes "Bulbo" → "Corteza olfativa" → "Integración: memoria, emoción y sabor". Separate callout "La vía inicial no exige un primer relevo talámico". Smaller second line "Esto no excluye participación talámica posterior". No complicated brain tract illustration; small tasteful brain silhouette.
Footer band "Receptor olfatorio = neurona | Receptor gustativo = célula epitelial". Small source footer "Saladin · cap. 16 · PDF 621–623 | Código combinatorio: Malnic et al., Cell 1999". All content Spanish exact spelling; no additional claims or unreadable small text. Original anatomic science illustration, precise receptor-to-axon polarity, no irrelevant generic icons.
